name: session-status
description: Two rows of Catppuccin Macchiato split pills above the prompt (solid icon, soft value; Nerd Font round caps in the terminal): work item (its Azure DevOps title on hover), git branch, active-time timer and subagent counts, then a context bar (token count on hover) and CPU/RAM/temperature (Windows only); plus a session title with the work item title (needs the Azure CLI, read-only)
